title: 30kW / 80kWh Factory BESS Reference in Austria
summary: A 30kW / 80kWh cabinet BESS reference for a factory site in Austria.
challenge: Factory loads combine peak demand, production continuity and a protection strategy that has to satisfy local electrical standards. The site needed those three settled together rather than one at a time.
solution: A cabinet BESS at 30kW / 80kWh, sized against the plant's load profile, PV status and required backup duration.
